views.text: In July 2024, a guest on Equity Mates described Galaxy Entertainment as a Macau casino operator with a prominent set of properties on the Macau strip, benefiting from heavy Chinese tourism and strong foot traffic through its doors.

views.text: In July 2024, a guest on Equity Mates contrasted Galaxy’s local ownership with MGM China and Sands China, saying local ownership could be viewed more favourably by regulators, while noting geopolitical risk and the importance of licences granted by the local regulator.
